title: Chainsaw Man: The Assassins Arc Releases New Trailer
content: Studio MAPPA is firing on all engines as a part of its fifteenth anniversary celebration, with the production house already giving fans a look at the fourth season of Jujutsu Kaisen .
author: ComicBook

title: A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even TV Anime Reveals More Cast
content: The staff for the television anime of Metabo Hagure 's A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even: How I Crushed My Homeland with My Mighty Grimoires ( Buchigire Reijō wa Hōfuku wo Chikaimashita. Madōsho no Chikara de Sokoku wo Tataki Tsubushimasu ) light novel series revealed two more cast members on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Dorohedoro Anime's 3rd Season Reveals Teaser Video
content: The " MAPPA 15th Anniversary Lineup Reveal" livestream event on Friday revealed a teaser video for the third anime season based on Q Hayashida 's Dorohedoro manga. The second season was previously scheduled to debut in 2025.
author: ANN

title: MAPPA Reveals Jimoto Saiko! Anime For Release on Netflix
content: The " MAPPA 15th Anniversary Lineup Reveal" livestream event on Friday revealed that it is producing an anime adaptation of usagi 's Jimoto Saikō! (Hometown is the Best!) manga that will stream on Netflix worldwide.
author: ANN

title: Chainsaw Man Assassins Arc Anime's 2nd Teaser Unveils Staff
content: The anime studio MAPPA presented the second teaser for the Chainsaw Man Assassins Arc anime during its live-streamed "15th Anniversary Lineup Reveal" event on Friday. The teaser confirms the main staff. Tatsuya Yoshihara is returning from Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc to direct the next anime at MAPPA .
author: ANN

title: MAPPA Shares Exciting Updates for Its Upcoming Projects, Including Jujutsu Kaisen S4, Chainsaw Man, Special MV & More
content: MAPPA held its 15th Anniversary Lineup Presentation on June 19, revealing two new anime productions while sharing updates on several of its major titles. The event also premiered a special anniversary music video for “Seikatsu” (“Life”), a song written by PEOPLE 1 to commemorate the studio’s 15th anniversary.
author: Anime Corner

title: Rich Girl Caretaker Releases New Trailer
content: Rich Girl Caretaker anime released a new trailer on Friday, featuring the ending theme song “Kanpeki janai watashi” by Ami Maeshima. The anime is slated to premiere on July 4. title: Jujutsu Kaisen Studio Officially Confirms Anime Remake of Hit Shojo Series & Reveals First Look
content: As one of the largest animation studios in recent years, MAPPA commemorated its 15th anniversary with an exciting event. The studio dropped all the new information on its upcoming projects, along with sequels and new adaptations.
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Unleashes First Trailer With New Details
content: Earlier this year, one of the biggest anime around ended the first half of its fourth season as Jujutsu Kaisen brought the first phase of the Culling Game to a close with one of the biggest fights of the year.
